call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one finished flat typographic poster, portrait 2:3.
Create ONLY ONE new original poster. There are no reference images. The overall set is managed by the coordinator; this call owns only this one direction.

Full original user request (do not print the request as extra copy): 덕테이프 포스터로 '숨과 숨 사이'를 5장 만들어줘. 검은 글자와 흰 여백만 써줘. 문구는 한 번만 넣고, 그림·도형·테두리·구분선·질감·장식 기호·추가 문구는 넣지 마. 줄바꿈은 어절 사이에서만 해도 좋아.

Assigned visual direction: 세 어절을 위에서 아래로 읽히게 하여 두 번의 호흡 사이를 수직 여백으로 체감시킨다.
가까운 방향과 구분할 관계: M3은 두 '숨'을 같은 줄의 동등한 쌍으로 읽게 하고, M2는 세 어절의 수직 순서와 중간 '숨'의 상대적 비중으로 작동한다.

The ONLY printed text is exactly this phrase once: 숨과 숨 사이
Render the phrase as exactly three intact word-lines in this order:
숨과
숨
사이
Both occurrences of 숨 belong to the original wording. Never omit either, never add a third occurrence. No quotation marks or labels.

Design the vertical pauses as the primary composition. Use a modern upright Korean sans-serif with clearly formed Hangul, generous internal counterspaces, natural uncompressed proportions, and optically precise spacing. The three word-lines share one clear left edge around the first third of the poster. Put 숨과 in the upper quarter, a substantially larger and heavier 숨 near the middle, and 사이 in the lower quarter. Let the large middle 숨 be the center of visual gravity; the upper and lower word-lines have matching restrained scale and weight. Keep ample deliberate white intervals between the three intact words, so the eye reads top to bottom through breathing space. The large middle word should remain one complete intact Hangul syllable, not an invented symbol or dismantled construction. Give the three lines enough width and margin to prevent any clipping or accidental near-touching. All typography is solid flat black.

Mandatory conditions:
- Only black letters on a pure white opaque single-color background. No gray intentional elements.
- Show the original phrase exactly once. Preserve all three words and their order.
- No illustration, icon, shape, border, rule, separator, texture, decorative character, extra copy, logo, watermark, mockup, 3D effect, shadow, embossing or paper surface.
- Line breaks only between words; never break or ornament the internal Hangul letter structure.
- One planar poster filling the entire frame, portrait 2:3.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

EDIT OF THE SUPPLIED POSTER: The only defect being corrected is the nonflat surface rendition. The background still has very faint grain, and several black strokes still have a pale parallel duplicate below them. Preserve the existing spelling and three-word arrangement; do not redesign the glyphs or move the layout. Rebuild the visual as truly flat DIGITAL TYPOGRAPHY with a white canvas and black ink areas, rather than a photograph of printed paper. Treat white space as blank untextured white data, not paper with lighting. All empty space must be uniform pure white #FFFFFF. All large letter interiors must be uniform pure black #000000. The black glyph edges should terminate cleanly at the white surface; no offset duplicate edge, pale gray parallel band, blur, light rim, shadow, raised printing or paper noise. Ordinary thin raster antialiasing can exist only exactly on a boundary, without extending beneath it as a second stroke.
Keep the top line 숨과, the enlarged center 숨, and the bottom 사이, all intact and readable, exactly one occurrence of the complete phrase 숨과 숨 사이. Retain the existing approximate shared left edge, scale proportions, and large vertical intervals. Keep all three words safely inside the frame. Opaque portrait 2:3. Only the exact Korean text and flat white background may appear. No additional text, illustrations, decorations, shapes, rules or texture of any kind.
